home.title: Your real estate project, in good hands
home.lead: Whether you're buying, selling or renting, Akili supports you at every step with personalised follow-up and a deep knowledge of the local market.
home.aboutP1: Akili is a real estate agency that supports individuals and professionals in their buying, selling and renting projects. We know the ground: every neighbourhood, every type of property, every administrative step. We put this knowledge at the service of your project, with clear advice and a dedicated contact from the first conversation to the signature.
home.aboutP2: Our approach is simple: listen to you, understand your real need, and offer tailored solutions rather than a generic list of properties.
home.featureSaleText: Sell or buy with peace of mind, with full support through to the signature.
home.featureRentText: A good tenant, a good home: we handle the matching and the follow-up.
home.featureEstimateText: The fair value of your property, based on a precise knowledge of the local market.
home.featureAdviceText: Simplified procedures and clear advice, from the search to the signature.
home.ctaTitle: Have a real estate project in mind?
home.ctaText: Let's talk about it. Our team responds quickly.

assistant.title: Akili assistant
assistant.subtitle: Quick answers to your questions
assistant.greeting: Hello! How can I help you? Pick a question below.

buy.q: How do I buy a property?
buy.a: Browse our catalogue, then click "Make a request about this property" on the listing you like. An advisor will get back to you to arrange a visit.

sell.q: I want to sell my property, how does it work?
sell.a: Fill in the "Sell a property" form with the main details (type, city, surface, asking price). We will get back to you to value the property and prepare its listing.

rent.a: Our rentals are shown in the catalogue with the "Rent" label. Can't find what you need? Describe your search and we will suggest suitable properties.

estimate.a: Yes, we value your property based on our knowledge of the local market. Contact us to book an appointment.

documents.q: Which documents do I need to sell?
documents.a: Usually: an ID document, the title deed (or land register booklet) and the property's planning documents if you have them. An advisor will give you the exact list for your situation.

services.a: Sale and purchase, rental, valuation and administrative support: we stay with you from the first visit to the signature.

nin.a: The national identification number lets us identify each client reliably and secure the procedures. It is only used to process your file.

contact.q: How can I talk to an advisor?
contact.a: Write to us through the contact form or reach us directly on WhatsApp, we reply quickly.
